response.sql: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT powerstatus, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY powerstatus), status_shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, telescope_count * 1.0 / (SELECT SUM(telescope_count) FROM status_counts) AS share FROM status_counts), average_share AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS value FROM status_shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share.value) AS average_amount_above_average FROM status_shares CROSS JOIN average_share WHERE share > average_share.value;
